zh-CN.title: 小程序成长授章即时出现
items: 打开小程序和回到前台时会立即检查成长升级，并在使用期间持续同步
待领取的升级现在会可靠进入全屏三幕授章仪式

en.title: Growth ceremonies now appear reliably
items: The Mini Program now checks for level-ups on launch, foreground return, and throughout active use
Pending upgrades reliably open the full-screen three-act medal ceremony
